# Third-party test fixtures

Generated by `script/fetch_fixtures`. Each directory below is an unmodified
excerpt of the named upstream repository at the pinned commit, except where a
derived file is noted. Upstream license texts are copied into each directory.

## html5lib-tests/

- Source: [html5lib/html5lib-tests](https://github.com/html5lib/html5lib-tests/tree/c777c408b61078ea2eb4acefc2535f54dbc8b28a) at `c777c408b61078ea2eb4acefc2535f54dbc8b28a`
- License: MIT (`LICENSE`)
- Purpose: Tokenizer, serializer and encoding-sniffing conformance tests. Tree-construction tests no longer live here; see wpt-parsing.

## wpt-parsing/

- Source: [web-platform-tests/wpt](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/tree/68d964a5f292bc4b2c2eba2f21e2b916190b6ad2) at `68d964a5f292bc4b2c2eba2f21e2b916190b6ad2`
- License: BSD-3-Clause (`LICENSE.md`)
- Purpose: html5lib-format tree-construction tests (the maintained copy), plus fragment-serialization tests kept as reference.

## wpt-selectors/

- Source: [web-platform-tests/wpt](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/tree/68d964a5f292bc4b2c2eba2f21e2b916190b6ad2) at `68d964a5f292bc4b2c2eba2f21e2b916190b6ad2`
- License: BSD-3-Clause (`LICENSE.md`)
- Purpose: Data tables behind querySelector/matches tests (JS object literals, not executable fixtures) and the HTML document they run against.

## wpt-sanitizer-api/

- Source: [web-platform-tests/wpt](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/tree/68d964a5f292bc4b2c2eba2f21e2b916190b6ad2) at `68d964a5f292bc4b2c2eba2f21e2b916190b6ad2`
- License: BSD-3-Clause (`LICENSE.md`)
- Purpose: Sanitizer API tests. The .sub.dat files are html5lib tree-construction format extended with a #config section; {{host}} must be substituted.

## dompurify/

- Source: [cure53/DOMPurify](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/tree/b7e0edc1293359d6ab54dc0ccc9cf9bbdd72aff7) at `b7e0edc1293359d6ab54dc0ccc9cf9bbdd72aff7`
- License: Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0 (`LICENSE`, `LICENSE-MPL`)
- Derived: `expect.json` is a JSON conversion of `expect.mjs`
- Purpose: Payload/expected pairs including SVG/MathML mXSS cases. Expectations are browser-DOM-specific; use payloads as attack inputs, not as exact oracles.

## nokogiri/

- Source: [sparklemotion/nokogiri](https://github.com/sparklemotion/nokogiri/tree/2d0f04bd124e18648fdb967fea0c4d94ff82b5d0) at `2d0f04bd124e18648fdb967fea0c4d94ff82b5d0`
- License: MIT (`LICENSE.md`)
- Purpose: HTML5 (gumbo) parse/serialize and CSS selector behavior to match, plus the DOM contract: Node, NodeSet, fragments, reparenting, attributes, XPath, subclassing and decorators. Most DOM tests parse staff.xml; port them to HTML. The HTML4 tests show the API shape; their libxml2 output doesn't apply (plan.md decision 3). helper.rb is there to read the tests, not to run.

## libxml2/

- Source: [GNOME/libxml2](https://github.com/GNOME/libxml2/tree/04af2cabb9f859c198b8a553c028a87481199410) at `04af2cabb9f859c198b8a553c028a87481199410`
- License: MIT (`Copyright`)
- Purpose: libxml2's XPath regression expressions, one per line: the expr ones need no document. The differential harness evaluates them with Nokogiri and lobzique on an HTML page.

## loofah/

- Source: [flavorjones/loofah](https://github.com/flavorjones/loofah/tree/541c07b8b0562f16299b8dac70cc3a553e9a0cec) at `541c07b8b0562f16299b8dac70cc3a553e9a0cec`
- License: MIT (`MIT-LICENSE.txt`)
- Purpose: Scrubber API contract and sanitizer vectors. assets/testdata_sanitizer_tests1.dat is JSON keyed by libxml2 version, showing where output already varies.

## rails-html-sanitizer/

- Source: [rails/rails-html-sanitizer](https://github.com/rails/rails-html-sanitizer/tree/9206a0bfd82df900e0ee4cbed496e8268403ed81) at `9206a0bfd82df900e0ee4cbed496e8268403ed81`
- License: MIT (`MIT-LICENSE`)
- Purpose: Full/Link/SafeList sanitizer behavior; the primary acceptance suite.

## rails-dom-testing/

- Source: [rails/rails-dom-testing](https://github.com/rails/rails-dom-testing/tree/153dbecf2601a71639a6a37ad8fd5da9d79e5ced) at `153dbecf2601a71639a6a37ad8fd5da9d79e5ced`

- Purpose: assert_select / assert_dom semantics, including parser selection.

## rails/

- Source: [rails/rails](https://github.com/rails/rails/tree/d5c10191684c845d4ddb53587d3a2965270369fc) at `d5c10191684c845d4ddb53587d3a2965270369fc`
